faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO DEBEL Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/BTech in Mechanical Engineering with 1st Division and a valid GATE score, or an ME/MTech in Mechanical Engineering with 1st Division at both graduate and postgraduate levels.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DRDO DEBEL Junior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of applications, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, offering a fixed-term engagement for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Defence Bioengineering and Electromedical Laboratory (DRDO DEBEL) located?
faq.answer: Defence Bioengineering and Electromedical Laboratory (DRDO DEBEL) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560075.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Bengaluru, Karnataka. While not explicitly stated that only residents can apply, candidates should check the official notification for any residency requirements or location-specific preferences.
